subject.title: feat(talk): enable GPT Live with Codex OAuth

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a supported public plugin-SDK browser-session broker contract for Codex OAuth realtime, including ownership of compatibility with Codex's experimental realtime API?
rationale: The patch can be mechanically refined, but only maintainers can choose whether this becomes a durable external plugin API and supported product capability.

options.title: Approve the broker contract
options.body: Adopt the broker as a documented SDK capability, define lifecycle and compatibility expectations, and require end-to-end OAuth-only proof before merge.

options.title: Keep it internal for now
options.body: Avoid exporting the broker from the public SDK and defer external-plugin extensibility until maintainers define the permanent contract.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this capability until Codex realtime stabilizes or an owner commits to its upgrade and support burden.

recommendation.title: Approve the broker contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the broker as a documented SDK capability, define lifecycle and compatibility expectations, and require end-to-end OAuth-only proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-surface product and public-SDK boundary decision rather than a narrow implementation correction.
